output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

source("00-paths.R")
```

read in and transform randomization data
```{r}
juice <- read.csv(file.path(paths$box, "P426HONC60BeWell_DATA_LABELS_2021-10-20_1538.csv")) %>%
  select(Subject.Number, Randomized.to.receive.683.at) %>%
  na_if("") %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rename("placebo" = Randomized.to.receive.683.at)
```

read in and transform subject data for stool sample completeness
```{r}
subs <- read_excel(file.path(paths$box, "bewell_studyschedule-v1.xlsx"), sheet = 4) %>%
  select(c(1:17)) %>%
  na_if("m")

subs$Subject.Number <-as.integer(substr(subs$`Subject ID`, 8, 10))
```
merge
```{r}
juice <- merge(juice, subs)
```

remove samples missing more than 1 stool tub
```{r}
cnt_na <- apply(juice, 1, function(z) sum(is.na(z)))

juice <- juice[cnt_na < 2,]
```

```{r}
juice <- juice %>%
  select(`Subject ID`, Subject.Number, placebo) %>%
  mutate(rB = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", paste0(juice$`Subject ID`,"-v3"), paste0(juice$`Subject ID`,"-v1"))) %>%
  mutate(tB = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", paste0(juice$`Subject ID`,"-v4"), paste0(juice$`Subject ID`,"-v2"))) %>%
  mutate(rP = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", paste0(juice$`Subject ID`,"-v1"), paste0(juice$`Subject ID`,"-v3"))) %>%
  mutate(tP = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", paste0(juice$`Subject ID`,"-v2"), paste0(juice$`Subject ID`,"-v4")))
  
```

save CSV
```{r}
write_csv(juice, file.path(paths$box, "potential_mimic_subjects.csv"))
```

save CSV with all subjects
```{r}
write_csv(juice, file.path(paths$box, "mimic_subjects.csv"))
```
